title: Does a research subject foraging by the connectome model's mushroom body adapt when the world changes, and which mechanism does the adapting?
preregistration: Written before any run of this file. Agents, schedules, metrics, odours, seeds and criteria are fixed here. The codes come from the full LIF model once (fly_neural adaptive codes) and are cached outside the repository; every life then runs on them. Development (10 subjects, development odours) may run while code changes; held-out (30 subjects, the held-out odour sets of plasticity-v2-v783) runs once from a clean commit and is reported whatever it shows. ECHO's comparators are its own mushroom-body rate model (ported, tested equal to the TypeScript) and its two-miss place bookkeeping; neither is tuned.
what_is_simulated: A subject chooses one of the sites on offer by their odours, visits it, and eats if the food is there. It senses nothing else: no site identity, no food position. One visit is one decision; travel is not simulated. The full brain is not run during a life: each visit's KC and PAM activity is one of the odour's cached LIF trials, drawn at random. Only the KC -> readout-MBON synapses learn.
representations_note: dense is Shiu et al.'s weights; random is the sparse code's per-odour KC activity moved onto cells drawn at random (one relabelling per odour), keeping sparseness and dropping the connectome's structure.

protocol.note: As plasticity-v2-v783: each odour's ORNs fire, in total, what development odour A's 222 ORNs fire at 80 Hz, capped at 200 Hz.

odours_note: dev and H1/H2 are plasticity-v2-v783's development and held-out odours. I1-I4, the interference context of experiment E, use the four glomeruli with at least 30 ORNs that neither split uses (DL4, DM5, VA1d, VC3) and eight smaller ones, chosen by hand before any run; they are shown in both splits and are never the tested odours.

rule_v2.note: plasticity-v2-v783's constants; with a meal the compartments' dopamine is full (R = 1), without one absent (R = 0)

rule_v1.note: plasticity-v783's rule; D adds the odour's own PAM spikes in the cached trial to the reward's

approach_note: ECHO's approachThreshold (src/bethesda/fly/mushroomBody/params.ts): a site whose value exceeds it is worth going to; the best such site is chosen, and with none a site at random. The same rule for every neural agent; values are scaled 0-1 by the rule's largest possible depression.

criterion.note: trials to criterion: visits before the first 10 consecutive visits with at least 8 to the food site; the phase length when never reached

relocation.what: A: four sites, food at one for 40 visits, then at another for 60

reversal.what: D: two sites (A, B), food alternating between them every 30 visits, 4 phases (3 reversals)

retention.what: E: food at one of four sites for 40 visits; 100 visits in another context (I1-I4, food at one); back to the first four sites with no food: the share of the first 5 probe visits to the trained site

retention-fresh.what: E's control: a subject that never learned, on the same probe

long-life.what: Phase 7: 12 blocks of 50 visits, food moving to a different site each block; the subject is checkpointed, rebuilt from the checkpoint's text and restored after every block; the same life without checkpoints must make exactly the same choices

arms.name: full
arms.what: rule v2 on the antennal-lobe sweep's code

arms.name: v1-dense
arms.what: the merged rule on the merged code: the existing connectome mechanism

arms.name: v2-reward-uncoupled
arms.what: dopamine on random visits at the subject's own meal rate, unrelated to the odour visited

arms.name: echo-mb
arms.what: ECHO's mushroom-body rate model (random KC codes per cue name), as it values places

arms.name: bookkeeping
arms.what: ECHO's two-miss place bookkeeping: a non-neural heuristic

uncertainty: each arm's mean with a 95% bootstrap interval over subjects (2000 resamples); comparisons one-sided Mann-Whitney over subjects, alpha 0.01, uncorrected and reported as such

criteria.claim: Learning helps: after relocation the full subject reaches criterion sooner than one that cannot learn
and sooner than the existing connectome mechanism (v1 on the dense code)
and eats more per visit than the existing connectome mechanism
It reverses faster than the merged rule on the same code, which can only depress
At least 80% of full subjects reach criterion after all three reversals
After 100 visits elsewhere the trained site is still preferred more than by a subject that never learned
with at least 60% of the first 5 probe visits to it on average
Dopamine is needed: silencing it removes the gain
Dopamine must follow the meal: uncoupled from it, the gain goes
The code matters: v2 on the dense code relearns more slowly
The antennal-lobe change matters: v2 on the threshold-only code relearns more slowly

Persistence: every full subject restored from its checkpoint after each block makes exactly the choices it makes uninterrupted; the checkpoints chain by hash; the state holds as many numbers after every block
The same for ECHO's mushroom body
No degradation: over 12 relocations the full subject's trials to criterion in the last four blocks are on average at most 2 visits more than in the first four
Exploratory: ECHO's mushroom body, the bookkeeping heuristic, random codes, no dopamine threshold and a random forager, on every metric
